# User Story

As the FES core system
I want the point of destination field to be added to the json file sent to SR
So that it can be used by Strategic Reporting

## Acceptance Criteria

### ✅ Scenario 1 - Point of destination included

Given I have completed my catch certificate, non-manipulation document or processing statement
When I select to “Accept and create <document type>”
Then the field ‘pointOfDestination’ will be included in the json

And the field ‘pointOfDestination’ will be populated using the Point of Destination added by the user

**Technical Details**

**Processing Statement:**

- Update data/schemas/Strategic Reporting/ProcessingStatement.json in mmo-fes-reference-data-reader to accept the Point of Destination

- Update toSdDefraReport  in src/landings/transformations/defraValidation.ts of the mmo-fes-reference-shared-data to map Point of Destination into the object saved into defreValidationReports collection

**Non-Manipulation Document:**

- Update data/schemas/Strategic Reporting/StorageDocument.json in mmo-fes-reference-data-reader to accept the Point of Destination

- Update toSdDefraReport  in src/landings/transformations/defraValidation.ts of the mmo-fes-reference-shared-data to map Point of Destination into the object saved into defreValidationReports collection

**Catch Certificate:**

- Update data/schemas/Strategic Reporting/CatchCertificate.json in mmo-fes-reference-data-reader to accept Point of Destination

- Update toCcDefraReport  in src/landings/transformations/defraValidation.ts of the mmo-fes-reference-shared-data to map Point of Destination into the object saved into defreValidationReports collection
